# ESMC (`esmc`)

- **Layer**: L2 (data link)
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [PTP / ESMC / CFM / R-APS / 802.3ah OAM (P2)](../../protocols/timing-oam.md)

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ethernet2`](ethernet2.md) | First 8 bits of the payload when `ethertype` = 34825 (0x8809) | 10 (0x0a) |

| `reserved2` | `uint(24)` | `0` |   |   |
| `tlvs` | `tlv` — rest of the PDU | 2 items |   | TLVs (8-bit type, 16-bit length including the 3-octet header, Auto): QL TLV with the SSM code, Extended QL TLV with the enhanced SSM code, SyncE clock identity and cascaded clock counts. Octets after them (padding) are kept as one raw item. |

### `tlvs`

- Type 8 bits, length 16 bits.
- The length counts the type and length fields too.
- An unknown type ends the typed decoding (the rest becomes one raw item).

| Type | Name | Value fields | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | `ql` | `unused`, `ssm_code` |   |
| 2 (0x02) | `extended_ql` | `enhanced_ssm_code`, `synce_clock_identity`, `flags`, `cascaded_eeecs`, `cascaded_eecs`, `reserved` |   |
